exact_gates_derived_from_results_rerun_j.note: Rounded summary values 0.488942/0.551692 are NEVER used for the 1e-12 gate; per-QA arrays compared at 1e-12.

groups.LOW48: first 48 coordinates in ascending (abs(q_j), j) order = low query-magnitude proxy, NOT proven nuisance
groups.HIGH48: last 48 coordinates in ascending (abs(q_j), j) order = high query-magnitude proxy
groups.FULL96: all 96 coordinates, t=4 only, cosine/sign invariance control

fixed_interventions.transform: multiply BOTH document and query coordinates in group by positive t; no refit/recenter/SVD/mean recompute

scoring_conventions_verbatim_from_step2_.tie_priorities: default_rng(5_100_000 + ORD[char]*100_000 + t*100 + 99).random(N), t=0..19; ORD=resolution.json ordinals
scoring_conventions_verbatim_from_step2_.native: Hamming distance count_nonzero((C>=0) != (qC>=0)); rank lexsort((priority, distance))
scoring_conventions_verbatim_from_step2_.float: cosine (C@q)/(||C||*||q||) on CENTERED C; rank lexsort((priority, -score)); exact == tie convention, no tolerance
scoring_conventions_verbatim_from_step2_.fractional_R_at_3: mean over 20 tie-draws of |top3 cap gold|/|gold| with ORIGINAL gold-size denominators
scoring_conventions_verbatim_from_step2_.zero_norm: producer cos() verbatim: nonfinite scores propagate; NaN sorts last under lexsort; positive-t scaling preserves zero/nonzero pattern exactly

exact_expectation_formula: Uniform random tiebreak within each equal-score bucket. Partition docs into strictly-ordered buckets; expected gold in topK = gold in strictly-included buckets + slots_rem * gold_in_boundary / boundary_size; fractional = /|gold|. Single-gold special case matches plan recall(S,Tc,K). Float buckets use exact == equality; native buckets are integer distances.
primary_prediction: LOW48 endpoint contrast mean[delta(t=4)-delta(t=0.25)] > 0 with delta = native_exact - float_exact; cluster-bootstrap (2000 reps, seed 20260913, resample 30 whole archives, question-weighted means) interval excluding zero = 'consistent with this proxy transfer'; nonpositive = negative; wide = inconclusive. Never redefine nuisance after seeing outcomes. HIGH48 predeclared comparison; FULL96 true invariance control. Four benchmarks exist but ONLY PerLTQA is run here; no familywise claims.
secondary: Full curves; fraction of QAs with any decreasing adjacent delta as t rises (pointwise-monotonicity violation); sections (profile/social/events/dialogues) and single-vs-multi gold as exploratory; describe section curves without outcome-based nuisance redefinition.
theory_caveats: Theoretical t is not identified on real data; LOW48 proxy transfer may fail without refuting theorem.
Sign invariance under positive t is a mathematical tautology: verify byte-identity, do NOT call it evidence for the theory.
No unconditional multinomial from pair averages: gold is shared.
